recap.headline: White Mambas Bury LeParth James Alive
recap.subhead: Jamal Murray dropped 45 on the final day and a 9-1-1 sweep flipped Week 5 for White Mambas.

zingers.line: Jamal Murray's 45 points and Bam Adebayo's 24-15-12 turned LeParth James into a 9-1-1 crime scene and stole Week 5.
LeParth James finished 4-6-1 for the week after a 1-9-1 final-day beating; the power rankings say third, the scoreboard says otherwise.
Suggs to be you lost a 7-2-2 night to Gopher Gold, thanks to Cade Cunningham's 15 assists on 2-of-9 shooting.
Adam Silver Dez Nuts lost the night 2-8-1 to MONSTARS and escaped Week 5 with a tie, nothing more.
Zero Fox Given punted steals and points, then lost the week 7-2-2 to Nova Knicks, a strategy that worked exactly as designed.

zingers.team: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw
zingers.line: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw lost the night 3-6-2 and still beat theInfamous 6-5 for the week.
BrookynDynasty won the night 7-3-1 with Nikola Jokic's 37-18-11 and still lost the week to Thug Life 6-5.

night: Jamal Murray, White Mambas: 45 PTS, 7 AST, 6 3PTM, 3 STL. Bam Adebayo added 24 PTS, 15 REB, 12 AST on the same roster.
Cade Cunningham, Suggs to be you: 5 PTS, 15 AST, 2-9 FG. Andrew Nembhard chipped in 16 PTS on 5-13 FG.
Left on the bench: nobody. Every player who went off was in someone's lineup, so no excuses for anyone.
Svi Mykhailiuk dropped 39 PTS with 10 3PTM on 12-23 FG. Buddy Hield had 33 PTS and 7 3PTM. Both are still on the wire.
Night's winner: White Mambas, 9-1-1 over LeParth James. Night's loser: Suggs to be you, who went 7-2-2 and was somehow still the worst team night.
